description: Go is a language for small tools and fast network services. It checks types before a program runs. These 12 starter lessons use small examples and simple words. Read the result, make one small change, and try the practice question. Install Go 1.22 or later. Save one complete example as lesson.go and run go run lesson.go.
learningObjectives: Use a small function with Go
